vera/composizione-negoziata.title: Track evidence and changes in a composizione negoziata
vera/composizione-negoziata.goal: Start an advisor case, review a draft and resume it when a receipt moves.
vera/composizione-negoziata.scenario: Entirely synthetic company: EUR 50,000 cash, EUR 100,000 expected on 15 November 2026 and EUR 80,000 payable on 30 November. The debtor has not confirmed the date; aging and orders are absent.
vera/composizione-negoziata.scope: First operational path: role, gaps, an actual treasury analysis, a note and review after a change. This is neither an eligibility opinion nor a complete professional case.
vera/composizione-negoziata.inputs: Open case-en.md for initial facts and assumptions. update-en.md contains only the new information for the practice phase.
vera/composizione-negoziata.request: Vera, I advise the company. Examine the synthetic inputs, flag gaps, run treasury forecasting and prepare an evidence-linked initial note. Do not assume any decision has been approved.
steps: In the working window, register the synthetic client and tutorial engagement. Vera distinguishes role, sources, assumptions and missing evidence before proposing the next activity.

Vera runs treasury forecasting with explicit coverage and assumptions, binds the saved result to the note and records a review only after your confirmation of that version. Open the model-data report.
Resume the same case with the update. Preserve the first note, inspect affected dependencies and request a new analysis. Previous confirmations remain historical.
deliverables: Case note with evidence, gaps, assumptions and next activity.
Executed forecast, saved revisions and a report of actual data use.
vera/composizione-negoziata.review: Trace the receipt from the reported fact to the forecast and note. A file does not establish collectability; a recorded confirmation is not a signature.
checkpoints: Distinguish the company advisor from the independent expert.
Identify unsupported assumptions and versions to revisit after the delay.
vera/composizione-negoziata.practice: Introduce update-en.md: the debtor now proposes 15 January 2027. Request a fresh analysis and note without carrying old confirmations into the new version.
vera/composizione-negoziata.success: You can start, review and resume a case while keeping limitations, dependencies and required decisions explicit.
vera/composizione-negoziata.repeat: Specify role, engagement, reference date and authorized real-case documents. Verify decisive legal sources at use; independence and conclusions remain professional responsibilities.
